title: Protect production updater key with trusted release environment
resolution: Added environment: release, ref guard requiring refs/heads/main, and pinned ref checkout to release.yml with contract tests in release-shell-contracts.test.mjs.

title: Verify Sherpa native archive before extraction
resolution: Vendored sherpa-onnx-sys 1.13.5 into patches/sherpa-onnx-sys-1.13.5 with SHA-256 verification table and tests in scripts/ci/verify-sherpa-archives.test.mjs.

title: Run secret scanner with trusted policy
resolution: Configured pull_request_target to check out trusted gitleaks config from base ref with persist-credentials: false.

title: Canonicalize encoded path separators before enforcing base directory
resolution: Added canonical decoded URL segment validation in commands.rs to guard against encoded traversal (%2e%2e, %2f, %5c) with unit tests.

title: Hold authorized audio-root capability through file open
resolution: Added AuthorizedAudioRoot capability wrapper and open_audio_import_file to prevent TOCTOU replacement races.

title: Preserve readable database when migration checksum changes
resolution: Preserves database path and reports clear integrity error when migration checksum changes, with regression tests.

title: Replace path-wide secret exemptions
resolution: Removed broad path exemptions and pinned strict rules with check-gitleaks-config tests.

title: Trigger Cargo checks when root toolchain pin changes
resolution: Added rust-toolchain.toml to trigger paths in build-desktop, lint-desktop, test-desktop-unit, and test-package-rust-transcription.

title: Do not report local-data cleanup success when audio cleanup fails
resolution: Propagated managed audio directory cleanup errors so cleanup reports failure if audio files fail deletion.

title: Bound and cancel detached updater signature download
resolution: Bound download_installer_signature with 30s timeout and 10s connect timeout with error propagation.

title: Include quarantined database copies in Clear local data
resolution: Implemented delete_quarantined_databases in open.rs and called it during clear_local_data with test coverage.

title: Accept or remove native Open review action
resolution: Implemented open review action in pill-review.actions.ts with unit tests.

title: Extend redaction to common credential labels
resolution: Broadened regex labels to include client_secret, private_key, session_token, password, credential with table-driven tests.

title: Stop Gemini retries after shared signal is aborted
resolution: Added abort signal check to retry loop and preserved deadline cancellation behavior.

title: Bound review text before every native draw
resolution: Added bound_review_preview_text (MAX_REVIEW_PREVIEW_CHARS = 3000) across macOS, GTK, and Windows pill crates.

title: Regenerate committed review evidence for this head
resolution: Pruned obsolete pr207 directory and established pr208 evidence directory.

title: Remove captured session transcript
resolution: Removed fully read this.txt.txt from tracking and added workspace hygiene contract in check-workspace-hygiene.test.mjs.

title: Parse pill event once and dispatch by type
resolution: Replaced substring matching with parse_pill_event JSON parsing and added unit tests.

title: Distinguish omitted field from explicit clear
resolution: Implemented clear_transcription_path flag and transcriptionPath: null support across backend and frontend repositories with unit tests.

title: Keep Node-native tests out of default Vitest run
resolution: Excluded run-tauri-dev.test.mjs and run-tauri-with-sidecars.test.mjs in vitest.config.ts, running them via node --test.

title: Correct top-anchored Windows pill origin geometry
resolution: Adjusted default_pill_y to subtract (WINDOW_H_TYPING - DICTATION_WINDOW_HEIGHT) with visible-footprint geometry tests.

title: Remove preloaded SQL plugin to prevent recovery file-lock collisions
resolution: Removed unused tauri_plugin_sql plugin registration from app.rs and removed sqlite preload from tauri.conf.json.

title: Clear-local-data removes quarantined recovery archives
resolution: Integrated delete_quarantined_databases into clear_local_data and added delete_quarantined_databases_removes_all_broken_archives test in open.rs.

title: Redact transcript text from provider errors and persist fixed failure categories
resolution: Added classifyPostProcessErrorCategory and redactTranscriptContent in transcribe.actions.ts and added sentinel transcript regression test in post-processing-failure.test.ts.

title: Restore onboarded CHECK (onboarded IN (0, 1)) constraint
resolution: Restored CHECK constraint in user_profiles schema, normalized copy via CASE WHEN onboarded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, and added rejection test in open.rs.

title: Canonicalize migration checksum line endings across LF and CRLF
resolution: Added CRLF-to-LF normalization before hashing in migration_checksum, enforced *.sql text eol=lf in .gitattributes, and added stability unit test.

title: Retire superseded agent run before message snapshotting
resolution: Aborts superseded run and cleans streaming state before buildConversationMessages, and excludes active streaming messages with integration test.

title: Prevent queued interim work and target probes from crossing sessions
resolution: Added sessionGeneration counter to DictationStrategy and validated generation before target probe and native delivery with regression test.

title: Arm setup deadline before window creation in composer review
resolution: Armed setup deadline at start of open() to destroy window and show recovery if window creation hangs, with unit test in composer.utils.test.ts.

title: Match .msi.zip and .AppImage.tar.gz archives emitted by pinned Tauri CLI
resolution: Updated INSTALLER_TYPES matchers for win-msi and lin-appimage, updated release.yml upload/verify globs, and added tests in updater-manifest.test.mjs.

title: Include rust-toolchain.toml in workflow path filters
resolution: Added rust-toolchain.toml to trigger paths in build-desktop.yml, lint-desktop.yml, test-desktop-unit.yml, and test-package-rust-transcription.yml.

title: Remove broad allowlist exemptions from secret scanning
resolution: Removed docs/**, reports/**, and session dump exemptions so all working-tree files are scanned.
